ch.what.when: Every report; “make” for goods, “do” for a service

ch.buyers.when: Buyers as the borrower names them, by how firm they are

ch.prices.when: Competitors’ price bands as the borrower lists them; no market figure of ours (rule 13)

ch.unit.when: A unit with a capacity (manufacturing or service)

ch.timeline.when: A loan drawn before sales start

ch.sales.when: Every report; products when sales are by product

ch.cases.when: A term loan; the cases from the trade’s rule file

ch.risks.when: Every report: each risk with what it hits, an early sign and a response (who acts and the case that tests it stay in the data)

ch.assume.when: Every report: each assumption with its value and what backs it, in words

annex.a.when: Every report: the full statements, less those a chapter already gives

annex.a.ratios.when: Every report with a balance sheet: each key ratio worked as a sum, every line copied from the statements

summary.when: Every report: one page, no verdict on the loan (D-DOC-03)

summary.favour.when: Findings that hold on the engine’s figures, or confirmed facts; three to five, never padded

summary.watch.when: Findings that miss a usual level or fall short in a case, then the risks’ first rows; three to five

summary.todo.when: Papers still to come and items still open

cover.when: Every report: the request and the contents on the first page, no chart
